newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica del Peru sets new div on '96 profits.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica del Peru sets new div on '96 profits.

text.p: Peru's Telefonica del Peru will pay another cash dividend of 0.11359 sol per share based on 1996 profits, the Lima Stock Exchange said Friday.
The bolsa said in its daily report that Telefonica -- the Lima exchange's benchmark stock that also trades ADRs in New York -- has not yet set a record or payout date for the dividend.
Telefonica has already paid a dividend of 0.06 sol per share based on last year's profits, the report added.
Telefonica is majority-owned by Spain's Telefonica de Espana after its $2.002 billion privatization in 1994.
